newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary industry, privatisation ministers sworn in.
newsitem.headline: Hungary industry, privatisation ministers sworn in.

text.p: The Hungarian Parliament on Tuesday confirmed Szabolcs Fazakas as the new minister of trade, industry and tourism.
Fazakas replaces Tamas Suchman, who was dismissed earlier this month in a scandal over irregular payments from the state privatisation agency APV to an advisor.
Judit Csiha was also confirmed in a newly-created post as privatisation minister. Privatisations were previously part of the portfolio of the minister of trade, industry and tourism.
Csiha is a lawyer and a MSZP Socialist Party member who was until now, state secretary at the justice ministry.
Analysts regard Csiha's appointment as more political than Fazakas' because she was once head of the party's faction in the Budapest City Council.
Fazakas was state secretary at the industry and trade ministry until the summer, when he was named ambassador to Germany, Hungary's biggest trade partner.
Information about whether Fazakas was member of any parties was not immediately available. The Socialist Party, the senior party of the ruling coalition, declined to disclose that information.
Both Csiha and Fazakas were nominated by Socialist Prime Minister Gyula Horn.
